strings.name: Shaun White
strings.summary: White won three Olympic halfpipe titles through difficulty, amplitude and consistency, while also winning X Games skateboard vert gold. His career connected snow and street board sports across five Olympics. He retired from competition in 2022 and shifted toward brands and event organization. He announced The Snow League in 2024, launched competition in 2025, and presented championship trophies as founder at the first season's 2026 conclusion.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 16, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Multiple Olympic titles helped take snowboarding from youth culture to a global mass-audience sport.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Born in San Diego, California, United States.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Three Olympic golds
strings.highlights.h1.text: Won snowboard halfpipe titles in 2006, 2010 and 2018.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education and early training
strings.facts.f2.value: Learned snowboarding and skateboarding in Southern California, with support from Tony Hawk and others.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Two board-sport disciplines
strings.highlights.h2.text: Won X Games gold in winter snowboarding and summer skateboarding.
strings.timeline.t1.title: First league season concludes
strings.timeline.t1.text: Presented Snow League snowboard championship trophies in LAAX; he was the founder, not the competing champion.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Snow League debut
strings.timeline.t2.text: His professional competition began in Aspen.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Announces new league
strings.timeline.t3.text: Proposed a professional format centered on snowboard and freeski halfpipe.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Retires after Beijing
strings.timeline.t4.text: Placed fourth in halfpipe at his fifth Olympics and ended competitive snowboarding.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Third gold in Pyeongchang
strings.timeline.t5.text: Won a third Olympic gold with his final run.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Vancouver title defence
strings.timeline.t7.title: Summer X Games gold
strings.timeline.t7.text: Won skateboard vert gold, demonstrating success across disciplines.
strings.timeline.t8.title: First Olympic gold in Turin
strings.timeline.t8.text: Won the halfpipe title on his Winter Olympic debut.
strings.timeline.t9.title: Winter X Games breakthrough
strings.timeline.t9.text: Won superpipe and slopestyle gold to enter the sport's elite.
